# CrossCopy

> CrossCopy is a free online clipboard for sending text between your phone, tablet and computer. Open a link or scan a QR code on another device and the text syncs in real time. No app, no sign-up.

- Website: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/
- Price: free, no account or sign-up
- Platforms: any modern web browser (Android, iOS, iPadOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS)
- Source code: https://github.com/SharoonRafeek/Cross-Copy
- Made by: Sharoon Rafeek (https://sharoonrafeek.com)

## How it works

1. Visit https://www.crosscopy.xyz/ and you get a new clipboard with its own short link (for example https://www.crosscopy.xyz/abcde).
2. Paste or type text into it.
3. Open the same link on another device, or scan the QR code shown on the page. The text syncs in real time as you type.
4. You can also choose your own link by typing any name after the domain, such as https://www.crosscopy.xyz/yourname.

## Good to know

- Text only, no files or images.
- Anyone who has a clipboard's link can read and edit it. Use the random link for anything sensitive, and press Clear when you're done.
- Text is sent over HTTPS and stored in Firebase Realtime Database until it is cleared.
- Works without installing an app, which makes it handy for shared or work computers.

# How to Copy Text From Phone to PC in Seconds

> Move clipboard text from mobile to desktop in a few clicks without installing any app.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/copy-text-from-phone-to-pc
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Why this workflow is useful

If you regularly switch between mobile and desktop, manual retyping wastes time and creates mistakes.

A shared link plus live syncing lets you move snippets, codes, and notes instantly between devices.

## Step-by-step

Open CrossCopy on your phone and paste the text you want to move.

Open the same link on your computer by scanning the QR code or typing the short URL.

Copy the synced text on desktop. Edit either side and the content stays in sync.

## Security tips

Treat shared links like temporary keys. Anyone with the URL can read the content.

Do not share passwords, banking details, or private credentials in a public or reused link.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need to install an app?

No. CrossCopy works directly in the browser.

### Does this work between iPhone and Windows?

Yes. Any device with a modern browser can join the same link.

# Share Clipboard Between Android and Mac

> A practical Android-to-macOS clipboard bridge that works instantly in the browser.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/share-clipboard-between-android-and-mac
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Common Android and Mac limitation

Apple Universal Clipboard does not include Android devices.

A neutral browser tool fills that gap with no vendor lock-in.

## Setup

Create or open a CrossCopy route on Android.

Open the same route on your Mac and pin it in a browser tab for repeat use.

Paste text on one side and copy from the other device immediately.

## Best practices

Use custom route names that are memorable but not guessable.

Clear old content after transfers to reduce accidental exposure.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I share long code snippets?

Yes, but keep formatting checks in mind after pasting into editors.

### Is this only for Chrome?

No. It works across modern mobile and desktop browsers.

# Cross-Device Clipboard Without Installing Apps

> Browser-first clipboard sharing for teams and personal workflows.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/cross-device-clipboard-without-installing-apps
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Why no-install matters

Install restrictions are common on work laptops and shared devices.

A web route bypasses app approvals and keeps setup almost instant.

## How to use

Open the same CrossCopy route on both devices.

Paste text into one session and copy from the other.

Bookmark frequently used routes for recurring workflows.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need an account?

No account is required.

### Can I use this on corporate machines?

Usually yes if browser access is allowed, but follow company policy.

# QR Code Text Transfer Workflow

> Fast route handoff from desktop to mobile with QR scan.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/qr-code-text-transfer-workflow
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## When QR is best

QR codes are ideal when URLs are long or you want to avoid typing on mobile.

They are also useful in demos or quick pair sessions.

## Workflow

Open a CrossCopy route on desktop.

Scan the QR code with your phone camera.

Start sharing text instantly in the same route.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I use a third device too?

Yes. Multiple devices can open the same route.

# Safe Clipboard Sharing Best Practices

> Practical security habits for browser-based clipboard workflows.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/safe-clipboard-sharing-best-practices
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Threat model basics

Anyone with route access can read shared content.

Plan as if links can leak through history, screenshots, or copied messages.

## Checklist

Avoid passwords and API keys in shared routes.

Use unique routes per session.

Clear content after use and close stale tabs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is data encrypted end-to-end?

Assume route-based access control only and avoid sensitive secrets.

# CrossCopy vs Alternatives for Text Sharing

> A realistic comparison of convenience, compatibility, and privacy tradeoffs.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/crosscopy-vs-alternatives
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Comparison dimensions

Speed, compatibility, setup friction, and privacy controls are the most practical criteria.

No single option wins for every use case, so pick based on device mix and sensitivity.

## Where CrossCopy fits

CrossCopy is strongest when devices are from different ecosystems and you need zero install.

Native tools can be smoother inside one ecosystem but usually fail cross-platform.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is this better than sending yourself messages?

For quick snippets, a live route is faster and avoids inbox clutter.

# Clipboard Sync Troubleshooting Guide

> A quick troubleshooting flow for slow or missing text updates.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/clipboard-sync-troubleshooting
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Fast diagnostics

Confirm all devices are on the exact same route URL.

Refresh stale tabs and verify internet connectivity on each device.

## Common fixes

Close duplicate tabs that may show outdated content.

Try a new route to rule out stale session issues.

Disable aggressive privacy extensions temporarily if updates are blocked.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Why do I see old text?

Most often a stale tab or wrong route URL is open on one device.


---

# Privacy-Focused Clipboard Sharing Guide

> Use route discipline and minimal data exposure to reduce privacy risks.

Source: https://www.crosscopy.xyz/docs/privacy-focused-clipboard-sharing-guide
Published: 2026-02-07 · Updated: 2026-02-07

## Privacy principles

Share the least amount of text required for the task.

Prefer one-time routes for temporary operations.

## Operational habits

Rotate route names for different contexts.

Never post active route URLs in public chats or tickets.

Clear route content when the transfer is complete.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can teams use this safely?

Yes, with clear internal policy on route sharing and content sensitivity.
